scope: Complete tracked-file inventory at this source revision. Copy comparisons cover only the three named local surfaces and source-listed members; they do not establish discovery, active provider, invocation, all-host coverage, or semantic equivalence.
method: git ls-tree -r -l HEAD; SHA-256 of tracked blob bytes (a symlink is hashed as its link text); manifest inclusion; literal frontmatter and client metadata inspection; byte-digest comparisons against source-listed skill members.
